title: Boone County Planning Commission — Checklists baseline reconciliation
scope: This reconciliation accounts for every unique PDF linked under Documents/Applications Forms/Checklists/ on the preserved Boone County Planning Commission Applications and Forms page as either an archived verified PDF or a verified source-availability gap. Archived status means bounded source-identity evidence exists for that checklist. Source unavailable means bounded official-source retrieval attempts did not return the listed PDF and no PDF contents are claimed. This inventory does not assert that any checklist applies to a particular sign project or that every instruction, requirement, fee, procedure, or approval path inside a listed checklist is current.
nextCategoryReason: The preserved official page contains a separate Applications PDF category that should be reconciled independently after Forms and Checklists.
